items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: But I heard them on that, they played nothing like the New Orleans jazz.

ctx.x: Back to Florida for a minute. What were the bands like in Florida other than the band you were with?

Well, the band in Florida I saw, the leading band around at that time was a woman named, in Pensacola, was Florida Beck. She was a woman who had learned to play classical piano to play jazz. And she was instrumental in bringing us to Florida. But they had another band around there called Fat Daddy, or Lazy Daddy. He was a little fat dogcat and had a band and a huge bass drum. And it was something like a trio quartet. But I heard them on that, they played nothing like the New Orleans jazz. They had more like what…
That's a little licky head on .
